title: 第029章 燃德清音诛魔将，残躯沥血护苍生
content_zh:
“深奥就对了，你仔细查看过没有？这个城堡里到底怎么回事？”身为领头人，龙刺必须时刻了解团队此刻身处的环境。

    “缘何？不就是想吃个饭而已？！”宛缨不掩饰心里的不爽。这家店搞什么？吃饭先猜谜？

    三长老听着高添琪那胖爷爷的称谓眉头皱的更紧了，却也不答话，一把抓起高添琪的左臂上的衣袖，猛地一下撸了上去。跟在三长老身后的秋儿离得最近，正瞧见高添琪左臂上的模样，却是哇的一声叫了出来。

    迟迟得不到回应，心急如焚的云秋梦恨不得能够替他出剑，几次三番出手却又及时将手收回，因为她想让阮志南亲自为父亲报仇雪恨。

    呼啦一声，两人肚上的断口处，流囘出一大堆的肠子。肠子流囘出，滚囘烫的鲜血也自上而下喷囘出，血溅长空。

    艺兴把月璃扶起来，伯贤领着边胜艺瞪着朴灿烈。灿烈有些懊悔和不要意思。没有人发现kris的神情很不对劲。这件事也算是就这么结束了。

    由于校长室是完全隔音的，所以外面的人只能看见里面人的动作，而听不到他们说的话。

    自古兵不厌诈，能让别人受伤，甚至干掉别人，其实也是一种是实力的体现。还没等李俊辰高兴几分钟，刘子梦眼神一冷，将绔扇咬在嘴里拔出了那只插在肚子上的匕首。

    宛缨点点头，拿起酒杯就往嘴里送。喉咙居然比大脑先反应。吞了一大半的宛缨“噗”的一声将嘴里剩余的酒吐了出来。

    吃力地转过自己的头看向了自己的右手，其实那已经不能称之为右手了，夏火整只右手都已经被炸得稀巴烂，白骨裸露在外面，惊悚至极。

    楚景贤手一甩，把九阴雷符扔了出去，雷符见风就涨，化作数百道紫色雷电，在前方炸了开来，硬是在那数百神灵梯队中，炸出了一条缺口。

    这时，抚弄剑身的虬须大汉，单手持起长剑，用手指在剑身上屈指一弹。

    刘龙陵松了口气，只要这位爷不搞事情，那他觉得应该就不会有事了。
content_en:
"That's right, it's profound. Have you checked carefully? What's going on in this castle?" As the leader, Long Ci must always understand the environment the team is in at the moment.

    "Why? Don't you just want to have a meal?!" Wanying didn't hide her unhappiness. What is this store doing? Do you guess riddles before eating?

    The third elder frowned even more when he heard Gao Tianqi being called Fat Grandpa, but he didn't reply. He grabbed the sleeve on Gao Tianqi's left arm and pulled it up suddenly. Qiu'er, who was following the third elder, was the closest, and when he saw the appearance of Gao Tianqi's left arm, he let out a cry.

    After getting no response for a long time, the anxious Yun Qiumeng wished she could draw the sword for him. She struck out several times but took her hand back in time because she wanted Ruan Zhinan to avenge her father personally.

    With a huff, a large amount of intestines flowed out from the cut in their stomachs. The intestines flowed out, and the hot blood spurted out from top to bottom, splattering into the sky.

    Yixing helped Yueli up, and Baekhyun led Bian Shengyi to glare at Park Chanyeol. Chanyeol felt a little regretful and embarrassed. No one noticed that there was anything wrong with Kris' expression. This matter can be regarded as over.

    Since the principal's office is completely soundproofed, people outside can only see the actions of the people inside, but cannot hear what they say.

    Since ancient times, soldiers have never been tired of deception. They can hurt others or even kill others. This is actually a manifestation of strength. Before Li Junchen could be happy for a few minutes, Liu Zimeng's eyes turned cold, he bit the fan in his mouth and pulled out the dagger stuck in his stomach.

    Wanying nodded, picked up the wine glass and put it in her mouth. The throat actually reacts before the brain. After swallowing more than half of the wine, Wanying spat out the remaining wine in her mouth with a pop.

    He turned his head with difficulty and looked at his right hand. In fact, it could no longer be called his right hand. Xia Huo's entire right hand had been blown to pieces, and the bones were exposed, which was extremely shocking.

    Chu Jingxian flicked his hand and threw the Nine Yin Thunder Talisman. The thunder talisman rose up when it saw the wind and turned into hundreds of purple thunder and lightning, which exploded in front of him, creating a gap in the echelon of hundreds of gods.

    At this time, the big man with a beard, who was caressing the sword, picked up the long sword with one hand and flicked the sword with his fingers.

    Liu Longling breathed a sigh of relief. As long as this man didn't cause trouble, he thought everything would be fine.
title_en: Chapter 029 Burning virtue and clear sound kill the demon general, and the remaining body sheds blood to protect the common people
